headline: [Nokhyun Square – Im Chae-un's Business Straight Talk] The political economy of the rising cigarette price increase
summary: South Korea has re-raised cigarette prices to secure fire-fighting funds. Commentary argues price policy should be reviewed to reduce the smoking rate.
why: Tobacco taxes and retail prices affect government revenue, public health spending and the earnings of listed tobacco makers.
